news.body:
## The passport is in and nobody downstream knows
- Marie Rose extended the tuition deadline to wait on your visa outcome.
That outcome has been in your hand since yesterday, and she asked where you were in the process. The board still says 24 November because no new date was ever agreed, so the mail that tells her is the same mail that gets you a real one.
- Your SBI branch is the other half of it.
The sanction is in, INSEAD would not give the undertaking, and the visa was the only thing still holding the transfer. Nobody at the branch knows that has been settled either.
## The KITAS needs a letter you cannot write yourself
- Ascentium wants a termination letter from Locus, and only Jishnu can issue it.
It is due on the 22nd, and of the three documents they asked for it is the one that is not yours to produce. The ticket and boarding pass are from a flight you have already taken.
